title: Photograph references for recognisable Nanded landmarks
method: Inspected actual photographs before modelling. Meshes and lettering were constructed originally in code; source photographs are linked for verification but are not redistributed or used as image textures. These are recognisable approximations, not photogrammetry. Dimensions, small sculptural details and exact frontage offsets are estimated.

models.name: Bhagya Nagar Kaman
models.locationBasis: Public place coordinate agrees within five metres with the OSM Bhagya Nagar entrance junction. Nearby OSM node7635002096 explicitly identifies Bhagya Nagar Kaman in its address.
observed: Large freestanding Marathi भाग्यनगर letters
Cream horizontal society-name beam
Dark stone central pier
Orange and bronze relief with standing and seated figures, trees, and a forward bust on a dark pedestal
Two flanking openings
Paired lantern-style lights
models.estimated: Overall width13.2m and height7.4m; central pier2.8m wide; side support positions are inferred because the reference photograph crops the outer edges. Relief is simplified and no unverified identity is assigned to the bust.
models.rejectedReference: Kupi.com's AI illustration was explicitly excluded; its caption identifies it as AI and its title incorrectly mentions Hyderabad.

models.name: Yeshwant College entrance
models.locationBasis: Estimated gate position at the eastern public-road frontage beside the southern academic footprint cluster. The official college homepage embeds a campus map centred at19.1698023434381,77.3091493977393. The source map does not survey the gate itself; exact entrance offset remains approximate.
observed: Two orange-red horizontally grooved piers
Broad cream rectangular lintel
Raised pale Marathi college lettering
Cream metal gate with rectilinear grid, diamonds and circular medallions
models.estimated: Gate width10.9m and height5.3m. Gates are shown open for passage, while the source photograph shows them closed. No building footprint was moved to accommodate the gate.

models.name: IIB Parnakuti
models.locationBasis: Official IIB directions link cid13803609631637388345 resolves to Parnakuti at this place pin. The mapped footprint contains the pin. Its north-east short edge is used as the visible facade; exact architectural frontage orientation is approximate because Street View is obscured by vegetation.
observed: White piers and three blue barred-window ribbons
Dark horizontal roof louvers and large red IIB lettering
Blue/red THINK NEET | THINK IIB lettering
Grey twin-entrance canopy, Parnakuti lettering, steps and wall-mounted AC
models.estimated: Facade width17.4m fits the original short footprint edge;14.4m height and relief depths are estimated. Exact facade orientation is not surveyed. The full mapped footprint remains intact.

models.name: RCC Coaching
models.locationBasis: Official Nanded centre embed is centred near this road frontage. June2025 Street View from19.1727869,77.309251 looking east confirms the identifiable tall RCC facade here. Current Google place pin19.1728752,77.3102965 is about100m inside the block and was not used as the facade centre. Footprint assignment is inferred from the road frontage, not surveyed.
observed: Tall cream horizontally grooved frontage
Two narrow dark louver shafts
Three blue-grey right-hand windows with thick projecting frames
Top recessed grille and parapet
Black name fascia with red RCC lettering and dark entrance steps
models.estimated: West facade width11.2m matches the original footprint edge. Height18m is estimated from visible storeys. The lower RCC wing to the south is not custom modelled. No invented student names, portraits or examination scores are shown.

models.name: Konale NEET Center
models.locationBasis: Official contact page provides Shyam Nagar address and short Plus Code58F5+6PJ, with an embedded map at this coordinate. The adjoining east-side footprint and west-facing frontage are inferred from that entrance point and the photograph.
observed: Off-white three-storey frontage and individual dark upper windows
Brown-framed glazed projection over right entrance
Red KONALE NEET CENTER and FOUNDATION fascia
Long left-side banner and grey ground-floor louver band
Steps, railings and colourful examination information boards
models.estimated: Facade width30.3m fits the original west edge; height10.8m is estimated. Small poster content is generalized; student photographs and exam claims are not reproduced. RCC and Konale are separate institutes.

verifiedButNotCustomModelled.name: Workshop Corner municipal overhead water tank
verifiedButNotCustomModelled.evidence: First-party bank and travel-office addresses and CensusIndia address list verify its presence; an unambiguous photograph and precise tower footprint have not been obtained.

verifiedButNotCustomModelled.name: Government ITI / Mahatma Phule statue frontage
verifiedButNotCustomModelled.evidence: Government prospectus verifies VIP Road near Mahatma Phule statue. Search images frequently depict other institutes; those have not been substituted.

verifiedButNotCustomModelled.name: Government Polytechnic Nanded
verifiedButNotCustomModelled.evidence: Actual campus photograph inspected; precise photo-to-building identification still needed before replacing a footprint with a bespoke facade.

status: Five photo-referenced landmarks are integrated. Their original map footprints are retained; facade relief and estimated building heights are included in collision. Kaman and college gate passages remain walkable. Each landmark has an accessible starting viewpoint. Facades are exterior reconstructions, not enterable interiors.
streetDetail: Water tanks, rooftop bases, rolling shutters, shade canopies and exterior AC units are stylized everyday details on existing footprints. Their individual positions are not survey observations. No roads or footprint outlines were moved.
